create_ArticulatedAgentManager: create an ArticulatedAgentManager instance from a SimulatorConfig and Simulator to manage all agent instances
on_new_scene_ArticulatedAgentManager: call on_new_scene on the ArticulatedAgentManager to destroy and re-create robot simulator instances for a new scene
post_obj_load_reconfigure_ArticulatedAge: call post_obj_load_reconfigure to set starting joint configurations with optional noise on all managed robots
update_agents_ArticulatedAgentManager: call update_agents to update all agent instance managers and their grasp managers each simulation step
first_setup_ArticulatedAgentManager: call first_setup to initialize IK helpers for all agents using their configured URDF files
